svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Turn a ring 88 mm outside, 62 mm bore, 10 mm thick.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Back face: recess 73 mm across, 5 mm deep, for the dome flange.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Front face: eight pockets 10.5 mm across, 3 deep, on a 75 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: circle, starting 22.5 degrees from the top, every 45 degrees.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: None sits at the bottom, where the fin passes.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Four 4.5 mm holes on an 80 mm circle at 45, 135, 225, 315 degrees.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: From each pocket drill 2 mm through to a 2 x 2 mm wire groove on the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: back face, and run it out at the crawler's lower right, by the lead hole.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: back face flat on the front wall, recess over the dome flange;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: four M4 x 16 screws. LEDs bonded in the pockets, wired in series,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: then the pockets and groove potted with clear epoxy.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the dome flange is gripped evenly; the dome does not turn.
